lastSession.summary: M2.3/M2.4 done. Added MaxPressureController (SWITCH only when opposite-axis pressure is strictly greater; deterministic HOLD-first tie-break; env enforces min-green + yellow). Split the observation into a base IntersectionObservation plus ObservationInput (base + AxisPressure). Rewired TrafficEngine to drive a Controller each tick (queueLengthsByEdge -> computePressure -> buildObservationInput + pressure -> decide -> applySignalIntent) with controllerKind 'fixed'|'maxpressure' (default fixed); Fixed uses env min-green 0 so its own timer alone decides switches. Extracted the shared scenario to src/simulation/scenarios.ts. The Fixed golden baseline is byte-identical (goldenRun fixture equality passes). Moved signal timing to constants (YELLOW_SEC/MIN_GREEN_SEC/FIXED_GREEN_SEC). Real balanced-4x4-v1 run (seed 41021, 1800s): Fixed avgWait 12.45s/p95 37.5/maxQ 5/thr 585/switches 1248; MaxPressure avgWait 3.15s/p95 11/maxQ 3/thr 593/switches 514 (recorded as-is, no superiority assumed). npm run check passes (118 tests + build); vite preview renders with no console errors. Remaining: rush scenario + saved comparison (M2.5/M2.6).
